evidence.quote: Day-old loaves go to half price at two in the afternoon
At close nobody is left to buy them

observations.why: Enacts price timing as a consequence-for-choice calculation: the discount is tied to when buyers are still present to act on it.

evidence.quote: so the price is never a surprise at the till

observations.why: Frames the shelf-card change as price information that lets the customer weigh cost before choosing, a proportionality framing.
